materials.name: Brickwork, outer leaf (exposed)
materials.source: BR 443 (2019) 3.6 (thermal conductivity); BR 443 (2019) 16 (specific heat capacity)
materials.notes: λ 0.77 W/(m·K) is BR 443 3.6: "Unless otherwise specified, brick thermal conductivity should be taken as: Outer leaves (of a cavity wall) 0.77". c 840 J/(kg·K) is BR 443 16, "Brick, concrete and stone". ρ and μ are not given by BR 443 and still need BS EN ISO 10456 Table 3.

materials.name: Brickwork, inner leaf (protected)
materials.source: BR 443 (2019) 3.6 (thermal conductivity); BR 443 (2019) 16 (specific heat capacity)
materials.notes: λ 0.56 W/(m·K) is BR 443 3.6, inner leaves of a cavity wall. c 840 J/(kg·K) is BR 443 16. ρ and μ still need BS EN ISO 10456 Table 3.

materials.name: Gypsum plasterboard, standard wallboard
